answer.rationale: The cost mandate and incumbent's refusal to reopen price make switching to the low-cost vendor the only option that meets the 18% target within the 14-day contract window. However, memory_c2 only speaks to cost, onboarding speed, and invoicing accuracy from a prior switch—it says nothing about sustained delivery reliability under tight volume conditions like the current 94%-of-committed, no-buffer state. Given that a full primary-vendor switch under time pressure could introduce exactly the delivery risk the objective prohibits, I want the archived record verified to check whether reliability/on-time performance was actually tracked or just assumed. I'm treating this as a guarded, closely monitored transition rather than a full-confidence broad rollout, keeping open the option to fall back or add the incumbent as a secondary source next cycle if early signals show strain.
